brand_faithful_inversions: Color tokens retained in hex format (matches captured brand surface and DESIGN.md Stitch frontmatter convention). OKLCH applies to new authoring; this is inheritance.

Saturated #e8b95e retained as the primary brand accent (existing brand uses it as the canonical voice; HSL saturation ~75%). The agent-default reflex toward tinted-neutral primaries is inverted per brand-faithful direction.

System-font stacks retained (SF Pro Display/Text + SF Mono, zero webfont bytes) — the captured brand runs deliberately on platform faces; the 'own a display face' reflex the benchmark set exhibits (National 2 Condensed, Geist, Euclid) is declined per brand-faithful direction.
Type-only hero with radial glow + starfield retained (no hero photography exists on the captured surface); the 'hero needs imagery' reflex is inverted per brand-faithful direction.
